strengths: Cover letter opening with specific regulatory team story is memorable and authentic—not generic company flattery
Gap acknowledgment is honest and confident: directly addresses document vs video and compliance exposure without being defensive
Resume shows clear progression from AI/LLM Consultant to Senior in 3 years with quantified scale (~100 to 300+ users, tens of thousands of documents)
Technical depth matches role requirements: RAG, vector databases, rerankers, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks all present
Narrative voice sounds human—phrases like 'I now believe deeply' and 'I should be direct about where my experience diverges' read as authentic
weaknesses: Company specificity could be stronger—mentions Panopto's mission but doesn't reference specific products, recent announcements, or unique challenges beyond generic 'video knowledge'
Resume bullets describe what was built but could include more business outcomes (time saved, accuracy improvements, adoption metrics beyond user counts)
Cover letter mentions 'tutoring interactions' as a Panopto challenge but doesn't demonstrate any relevant experience with interactive/educational AI systems
revision_suggestions: Consider adding one specific Panopto detail—e.g., reference to their search capabilities, a known customer use case, or recent product feature to deepen company research signal
Add 1-2 outcome metrics to resume bullets: efficiency gains (e.g., 'reduced document retrieval time by X%'), accuracy improvements, or business impact statements
The tutoring/interactive AI gap is worth a brief acknowledgment if the role heavily involves that—currently unaddressed
